data.name: OrbSiege
data.detailed_description:
Master the Flow. Minimalize the Count.

OrbFlow combines satisfying 3D physics, vibrant Low-Poly aesthetics, and mind-bending routing puzzles into a pure, unadulterated physics playground.

Your objective sounds simple: Fill the target pit with marbles. But victory is only half the battle—the true challenge lies in doing it with the absolute minimum number of balls launched.

KEY FEATURES

  • 🌊 Satisfying Marble Physics

    Watch hundreds of colorful marbles cascade, bounce, and collide across beautifully rendered Low-Poly 3D terrains powered by Unity 6.

  • 🧠 Less is More

    Every ball counts! Optimize your trajectory, leverage gravity, and engineer the perfect route to achieve 3-star ratings and set record-low ball usage.

  • 🛠️ Tactical Sandbox Devices

    Place and adjust various physics-based mechanisms—from wind blowers and jump pads to guide pipes and multiplier gates—to overcome steep cliffs and destructible obstacles.

  • 🏆 Global Efficiency Leaderboards

    Think you found the optimal solution? Compare your minimal-ball scores against players worldwide on the global leaderboards for every level!

  • 🎨 Clean & Relaxing Aesthetics

    Immerse yourself in crisp URP visuals, soothing color palettes, and tactile acoustic sound effects that make every launch immensely satisfying.

data.short_description: OrbFlow is a relaxing yet challenging 3D physics puzzle game. Launch streams of marbles down vibrant Low-Poly valleys, guide them through obstacles using physics devices, and fill the target pit using as FEW balls as possible. Compete on global leaderboards for ultimate efficiency!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz 或同等水平
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 或更高
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 或更高
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
